authority: Autonomous technical implementation; ADR-015 and independent ENTRY-P03 review; not content/legal approval

public_common_support.private_common_pool: For each admitted pair, >=ceil(.25*total_rounds) common friend_or_more comfort1 nonphysical/non-goingaway cards; otherwise private options unavailable
public_common_support.limitations: Hard X veto and J/comfort/context/capability exclusions remain; no zero social/observational-inference guarantee

invariants.profile: SHA256(seed:player/edge) gives comfort%5 and label%6; explicit neutral defaults separately tested
invariants.safe_refusals: Reported separately from completed synthetic games; no relabelled success

fairness.n2_limitation: Both invitation shares .5; no partner variety promise
fairness.gf_profile: N4 all-friendship vs first unordered pair G at equal comfort1, in_person, round1, questions, identical eligible pool

inference.profile: All other edges friendship; first unordered pair F=FR/FR,G=CR/FR,M=CR/CR; matched snapshot/pack/card-pool/public confounders
inference.features: Normalized counts of public interaction types, selected ordered member/pair roles, stage-private generic counts and public card-ID histograms; no raw secret fields
inference.classifier: Diagonal linear discriminant: train mean difference divided by pooled variance+1e-9; evaluate fixed holdout; orientation fixed by training
inference.structural_assertions: Zero explicit forbidden fields and zero unique deterministic class decoder in compatible common-support public repertoire; hard-exclusion limitations documented

failure_policy: Preserve initial FAIL, source/protocol hashes and seeds; any changed algorithm/threshold/profile requires a new protocol revision and independent review before rerun; no posthoc seed selection
